error[TypeError]: Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions
 --> case.js:1:11
  |
1 | const n = 10n + 1;
  |           ^^^^^^^ `10n` is a BigInt but `1` is a Number; arithmetic needs both to be the same type
  |
  = help: make both BigInt: `10n + BigInt(1)`
  = help: or make both Number (precision is lost above 2^53): `Number(10n) + 1`
  = stack: <top-level> (case.js:1)
